name: LAMINAR AIR FLOW (HORIZONTAL)
desc: Designed to provide a continuous, uniform stream of ultra-clean filtered air across a minimum 4ft workspace, achieving a strict Class 100 cleanliness level. Equipped with dual-stage filtration (10-micron Pre-filter and 0.3-micron HEPA filter).
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS LAMINAR AIR FLOW (HORIZONTAL) is a precision Class 100 / ISO 14644-1 Class 5 clean-air workstation that generates a steady, unidirectional horizontal stream of HEPA-filtered air across a minimum 4 ft stainless steel work zone. A washable 10-micron pre-filter captures coarse dust, while the primary 0.3-micron HEPA filter removes 99.97% of airborne particles, enabling reliable aseptic processing for microbiology, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical applications. In clinical and academic laboratories, doctors, B.Sc./M.Sc. students, PhD researchers, and chemists use this cabinet for sterility testing, preparation of nutrient agar, MacConkey agar, and Sabouraud dextrose agar plates, cultivation of non-pathogenic bacteria, yeast and fungi, plant tissue culture on Murashige and Skoog media supplemented with auxins and cytokinins, mammalian cell culture in DMEM or RPMI 1640 with fetal bovine serum and penicillin-streptomycin, and low-risk sterile compounding of non-hazardous aqueous preparations under USP 797, WHO GMP, and ISO 14644-1 guidance. The integrated high-intensity germicidal UV lamp disinfects the work surface between sessions, while the dynamically balanced blower maintains smooth, uniform airflow that sweeps contaminants away from the product. Because this is a product-protection horizontal laminar flow cabinet, it must not be used for strong acids, volatile organic compounds, flammable solvents, cytotoxic agents, or viable pathogenic microorganisms requiring biosafety containment, as horizontal airflow does not protect the operator from hazardous vapours or aerosols.
sop: Switch ON the main power supply and ensure the front sash/clear protective screen is intact and the stainless steel work surface is free of unnecessary items.
Turn ON the blower and allow the horizontal laminar airflow to run for at least 15 minutes to purge the cabinet and achieve stable Class 100 conditions before any manipulation.
Press the 'SET' button once to enter the setpoint mode for the blower speed/UV timer PID controller.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target parameter, such as a 30-minute UV sterilisation cycle or the recommended airflow setpoint.
Press 'SET' again to lock the value and allow the controller to maintain the selected parameter.

If surface sterilisation is needed, close the front sash completely, switch ON the germicidal UV lamp, and run the programmed UV cycle (usually 15 to 30 minutes). Ensure no personnel are exposed to UV radiation.

After the UV cycle, switch OFF the UV lamp, switch ON the in-built LED lighting, and wipe the work surface, side walls, and front sash with a lint-free cloth soaked in 70% isopropyl alcohol or 70% ethanol.

Load sterile media, culture plates, reagents, and instruments into the work zone so that clean critical items are placed downstream of the HEPA filter face, and never block the airflow path with large objects or clutter.

Perform all aseptic manipulations such as pouring agar plates, inoculating cultures, sub-culturing plant tissue, or preparing cell culture media inside the first 30 cm of the clean airflow, using aseptic technique and sterile gloves/garments.

After completing the work, remove all cultures and materials, disinfect the entire stainless steel surface again with 70% isopropyl alcohol, and allow the blower to run for an additional 5 to 10 minutes before switching OFF the system.

SAFETY WARNING: Never operate the UV lamp with the front sash open or while personnel are present, and never use this horizontal laminar airflow cabinet for strong acids, volatile organic solvents, flammable or cytotoxic substances, or pathogenic microorganisms because horizontal airflow offers no operator protection and can direct hazardous aerosols or vapours toward the user.
